updates.title: Welcome to the BlueDahlia Retreat:
body: Where Real Estate takes a break and makes space for a Real Escape.

This is a collection of Music, Food, and Art events occurring during your stay.
If you would like the information to cover a more specific area in greater detail, text me where your staying and I'll concentrate on those neighborhoods.

explore the app, there's a maps with every event's location and  button that will show you where you are. There's a way to favorite stuff and a toggle to see only those. See if you can figure it out and let me know.
I hope this is useful and easy to use. I boosted the font size to it's easier to read.
